name: E-commerce Packshot
description: A precise combination of quality, lighting, rendering, and material keywords for generating clean, white-background product photography suitable for Amazon, Shopify, or other e-commerce platforms. Requires pure white background, accurate color, visible edge detail, no cast shadows, and product correctly exposed with detail in both highlights and shadows.
description_zh: 精准搭配质量、灯光、渲染和材质关键词，生成适合 Amazon、Shopify 等电商平台的白色背景标准产品图。要求纯白背景、色彩准确、边缘清晰无阴影、产品正确曝光、高光和阴影处均有细节。
prompt_text: masterpiece, best quality, high quality, high resolution, detailed, 5K UHD, 4K UHD, 8K UHD, ultra-detailed, RAW photo, product photography, centered product, studio lighting, soft lighting, high key lighting, raytracing, sharp focus, clean edges
prompt_text_zh: 杰作，最高质量，高质量，高分辨率，高细节，5K UHD，4K UHD，8K 超高清，超精细，RAW 摄影，产品展示图，居中产品，灯光摄影，柔和灯光，高关键照明，光线追踪，清晰聚焦，干净边缘

example.description: Generate a clean white-background product photo of a coffee mug for an e-commerce listing.
example.description_zh: 生成咖啡杯的白色背景电商产品展示图。

input.product: a ceramic white coffee mug with a matte finish

example.output: masterpiece, best quality, high quality, high resolution, detailed, 5K UHD, 4K UHD, 8K UHD, ultra-detailed, RAW photo, product photography, centered product, ceramic white coffee mug with matte finish, studio lighting, soft lighting, high key lighting, sharp focus

notes: This bundle is optimized for Amazon/Shopify compliant product images. Key differentiators: high key lighting (0.9) for pure white background, studio lighting (0.9) for even illumination. Rendering engines (Unreal, Blender Cycles, Octane) add 3D realism. Use guidance_scale 8-10 for best product detail adherence. No pure_white_background or no_shadow keywords exist in the keyword database.
